approval.new_source: A fresh independent exact-head human GitHub review and full hosted qualification are required. The prior approval covers only the parent source.

correction: Mask systemd-hostnamed.socket with its already masked service and enforce both masks during runtime health checks.
Pass each unmasked boot socket explicitly to the native final assembly verifier so a masked or missing paired service fails before VM startup. Preserve /etc precedence over runtime masks.
When SSH boot health times out, query complete failed unit identifiers without forwarding the agent or retaining SSH stderr, journal text or raw console secrets.
Require reusable source checks before the PR cache handoff and package compilation, preserving the complete filesystem and native qualification gates.

failed_qualification.diagnostic_limit: The original serial diagnostic retained only d.socket as the socket identifier. It does not preserve the complete console. Exact matching-package native reproduction demonstrates the hostname socket defect; complete fresh hosted VM qualification is still required.

reason: Package compilation, package and vulnerability admission, native storage expansion and signed factory installation passed. The installed TPM2 profile then failed its first boot health check. The service-only systemd-hostnamed mask leaves a vendor-enabled socket whose paired service cannot load; this failure is independently reproduced with the exact installed systemd implementation.
